connector.name: Atomic Mail
connector.registryDescription: Programmable email inbox for AI agents - JMAP, PoW auth, stdio MCP server.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-modelcontextprotocol. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the atomic-mail account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_API_KEY
env.description: Existing API key — skips PoW registration

env.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_INBOX_DOMAIN
env.description: Default inbox domain when inboxId has no @ (default: atomicmail.ai)
